item.title: Disentangling the bidirectional associations of depressive symptoms, impulsivity, and substance use in early adolescence: A between and within person perspective
item.description: This study disentangles bidirectional associations among depressive symptoms, impulsivity, and substance use in early adolescence using between- and within-person modeling. The authors clarify how stable individual differences and time-varying processes jointly shape co-occurring internalizing symptoms and substance use behaviors.
